senses.sense_definition: Of or relating to Saint Peter, his writings, or the papal authority associated with him, or to Peter the Great of Russia.

examples.text: The scholar wrote an extensive commentary examining the theological themes found in the <w>Petrine</w> Epistles.
Many papal encyclicals emphasize the doctrine of <w>Petrine</w> supremacy within the governance of the Catholic Church.

senses.sense_definition: Depicted upside-down, especially referring to the cross of Saint Peter.

examples.text: The ancient cathedral featured a stained glass window displaying a <w>Petrine</w> cross above the altar.
He wore an inverted <w>Petrine</w> cross as a traditional symbol honoring the apostle's manner of martyrdom.
